description:
X2.5 Extreme Enduro 60V — the X2, turned up
The X2.5 takes our carbon X2 enduro eMTB and moves it to a 60V power system with a specially tuned Ludicrous V2 controller included — about 20% faster than the X2 Ludicrous, more responsive, with power across a broader RPM range. Each one is custom-built to order. You won't find this spec sheet under $5,000.

Bafang M600 mid drive — over 95Nm torque, torque sensor (5 assist levels) + throttle
60V 14Ah LG MJ1 battery (820Wh, 67V peak) — integrated, removable, locking
Ludicrous V2 controller included — up to 50 battery amps in bursts, 50%+ more torque, Bluetooth app
V2 carbon-reinforced PEEK silent gear standard (normally $300)
RockShox suspension — 160mm Yari fork, Deluxe Select+ shock
SRAM 12-speed & 4-piston brakes

Specifications

Motor
Bafang M600 mid drive, >95Nm, torque sensor (5 levels) + throttle, 7 lb, 36:1 reduction

Battery
60V 14Ah LG MJ1, 820Wh (67V peak), integrated downtube, removable, locking (2 keys), own charge port

Controller
Ludicrous V2 tuned for 60V — up to 50 battery amps (20-sec bursts), 50%+ more torque, 72V-rated, field weakening, thermal protection, Bluetooth app (Android/iOS)

Gear
V2 carbon-reinforced PEEK silent gear (normally $300)

Brakes
SRAM Guide 4-piston hydraulic, 200mm front / 180mm rear

Tires
Maxxis Minion or WTB Trailblazer 27.5×2.8; double-wall 40mm alloy rims

Frame
Carbon fiber, full suspension; dropper post, fully internal cables, Boost thru-axles

Sizes
S 16" / M 17.5" / L 19" / XL 21"

Warranty
2yr carbon frame, 1yr battery, 1yr PEEK gear, 6mo motor/components

A legit enduro eMTB
Top-end RockShox and SRAM components on a carbon full-suspension frame — specs you won't find under $5k. The Bafang M600 is small, light, and powerful, with torque sensing that makes it feel like a natural extension of your pedaling; in non-Ludicrous mode it's Class-1 trail legal. Luna stocks the full M600 parts line and backs it with a 6-month parts warranty. Build time is about 7 business days.
Sizing
When in doubt, size down. See the frame geometry and size chart below.

Options

Luna Advanced X2.5 charger — $125

THIS BIKE IS FOR OFF-ROAD USE ONLY. With the Ludicrous controller engaged it is no longer road legal in many USA states. The buyer takes full responsibility for proper use of this product.
